title: Storage: secure persistence
notes: 2026-08-26 bounded secure-persistence audit: NOT isolated or complete enough to claim. Python production python/src/lichen/crypto/key_persistence.py::FileKeyStore is already the exact target of in-progress P1 project-LICHEN-worker6-rxer (rollback/deletion/equal-generation divergence). Rust production rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs is already the exact target of in-progress P1 project-LICHEN-worker6-xyk3 (atomic no-replace publication), project-LICHEN-worker6-2502 (fail closed on storage errors/corruption), project-LICHEN-worker6-izg5 (0600/0700/no-follow/ownership), plus P2 project-LICHEN-worker6-so3l (recoverable first-boot transaction). Duplicate open bead project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.11.2.1 tracks persistent identity across reboots and documents the same owners. Platform acceptance is additionally unmet: spec/06-security.md §15.2 requires a hardware secure element or flash with readout protection, but Zephyr lichen/subsys/lichen/link/link_ctx.c persists ed25519_sk in a generic CRC-only NVS tuple, ignores save_tuple() errors in lichen_link_load_key(), and has no secure-element/readout-protection backend or associated identity persistence test. Python/Rust-only work cannot satisfy this all-platform key-lifecycle task, and excluded C/Zephyr must not be edited here. Leave open/unclaimed until the active storage beads converge and a fail-closed protected Zephyr key backend is implemented and tested. No files modified or tests run.
